shortDescription: Tesla NASDAQ:TSLA CEO Elon Musk says the company's long-awaited next-generation Roadster will be "sentient" and capable of performing driving stunts autonomously."You will be able to ask the Roadster to perform any of the tricks shown autonomously, as it will be sentient," Musk wrote in a post on X…

children: CEO Elon Musk says the company's long-awaited
will be "sentient" and capable of performing driving stunts autonomously.
"You will be able to ask the Roadster to perform any of the tricks shown autonomously, as it will be sentient," Musk wrote in a post on X.
Musk also said Tesla plans to build a looping test track at its Texas headquarters where Roadster owners can put their vehicles through their paces.
"We will have a wild looping track (crazier even than Hot Wheels) at our Texas HQ where you can test out your Roadster," he said.
Musk did not elaborate on what he meant by "sentient" or provide details on how the autonomous stunts would work.

title: Elon Musk says Tesla's Roadster will be 'sentient'
